messages:
maya-support: FYI ACME tenant on dedicated-cluster-78 reporting intermittent 500s for /v1/generate starting 2026-03-16T14:12Z. Seen ~10% of requests failing. Sample request-id: req-acme-20260316-0001

alex-eng: Can you paste the request IDs + a short curl repro? I'll try to repro in a staging copy.

maya-support: Request IDs: req-acme-20260316-0001, req-acme-20260316-0007, req-acme-20260316-0012. Quick curl they used (api key redacted):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl-16k","input":"summarize: The quick brown fox...","max_tokens":64}' 
  https://dedicated-usw2.redwood.ai/v1/generate?request_id=req-acme-20260316-0001
```

maya-support: Error in client logs: 500 Internal Server Error, body: {"error":"internal server error","request_id":"req-acme-20260316-0001"}

alex-eng: Ok. I'll need: pod logs for generator pods (server container), kube events around 14:00-14:20 UTC, node dmesg and GPU metrics. Maya can you confirm which namespace/tenant?

maya-support: Namespace is tenant-acme-prod. Pods: generator-0, generator-1. Node names: node-gpu-78a, node-gpu-78b.

lina-ops: I can grab node metrics and dmesg. Plan:
- kubectl -n tenant-acme-prod logs pod/generator-0 -c server --since=30m > /tmp/generator-0.log
- kubectl -n tenant-acme-prod get events --since=1h > /tmp/k8s-events.txt
- kubectl describe node node-gpu-78a > /tmp/node-78a-describe.txt
- ssh root@node-gpu-78a 'dmesg -T | tail -n 500' > /tmp/node-78a-dmesg.txt
- ssh root@node-gpu-78a 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.used --format=csv -l 1 -f /tmp/gpu-stream.csv & sleep 10; kill $!'

alex-eng: I'll pull the pod logs and core dump check: 
- kubectl -n tenant-acme-prod exec pod/generator-0 -- ls /var/crash || true
- kubectl -n tenant-acme-prod logs pod/generator-0 -c server --tail=500 > /tmp/generator-0-tail.log

eng-runtime-oncall: Also check runtime fallback traces: routing.log and batching.log for those request_ids. Command: 
- grep -E "req-acme-20260316-0001|req-acme-20260316-0007|req-acme-20260316-0012" /var/log/redwood/runtime/*.log > /tmp/routing-traces.txt

maya-support: Can we produce a debug bundle and upload to S3 for the customer? Need presigned URL.

ops-bot: support-collect initiated for tenant-acme-prod. Bundle id: bndl-2312345678. Upload URL will be available in ~2m.

ops-bot: Upload URL: https://presigned.example.com/support/bundles/bndl-2312345678.tgz (expires in 1h)

lina-ops: Bundle checklist I ran: 
- pod logs (generator-* server + sidecars)
- kube events + describe pods
- node dmesg and /var/log/messages
- nvidia-smi snapshot and one-minute sampling csv
- sar iostat for last 30m (if available)
- container runtime logs (cri/containerd)

alex-eng: For repro curl, try with the model pinned to the exact version the tenant uses (gpt-xl-16k:v20260301). Also try adding header X-Request-Id to correlate: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Request-Id: req-acme-20260316-0001" -d '{"model":"gpt-xl-16k:v20260301","input":"..."}' https://dedicated-usw2.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maya-support: I uploaded a small capture: s3://redwood-support/tmp/acme-repro-2312345678/curl-req-0001.txt (contains the exact payload).

eng-runtime-oncall: Noted a pattern: a few entries around the timestamps show "KV cache miss causing long lookup" and then a 502->fallback. Need to check kernel preemption traces on node-gpu-78a. If we see intermittent kernel GPU timeouts might be XID errors.

lina-ops: Collected files and uploaded to presigned URL (bundle bndl-2312345678.tgz). Files included: generator-0.log, generator-1.log, k8s-events.txt, node-78a-dmesg.txt, node-78a-describe.txt, gpu-stream.csv, routing-traces.txt

maya-support: Customer says issue started after a bursty traffic spike during billing batch at 14:05. Could be burst->batching pressure. They also flagged a billing discrepancy but agreed to separate ticket.

alex-eng: Next steps I will: reproduce with load test (200 r/s) against a staging replica of tenant-acme-prod with model pinned; check if batching overflow produces 500s; validate kernel logs for XID. Lina please keep the node metrics collection running for 1h.

lina-ops: Running metric collection for 1h and will share aggregated GPU utilization + memory graphs in this thread when done.

eng-runtime-oncall: If we confirm XID/kernel GPU resets, add node to maintenance, migrate pods, and escalate to infra for driver update scheduling.

maya-support: Thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and share bundle link. Please ping here when you have repro or a clear root cause. :thumbsup:
